scope.inclusion_rule: All five records with complete paired official metadata in EXP-TEMPORAL-PRODUCTION-001/linkage_adjudication.json, plus all eight accepted and one unresolved records with complete paired official metadata in EXP-TEMPORAL-PRODUCTION-002/nature_science_candidate_audit.json.
exclusions_from_denominator: EXP-002 rejected entries that do not retain both official titles and author evidence
false-positive examples without a corresponding journal candidate record
manifest records that retain only one title or a Boolean title-consistency assertion
scope.cohort_effect: None. This descriptive audit does not modify either frozen manifest, linkage decision, or benchmark cohort.

identity_evidence_order: exact canonical journal DOI in official arXiv metadata
explicit publisher or repository publication/preprint relation in official metadata
manual adjudication using official titles, author lists, and abstract or method content
classification_policy.title_role: Title comparison is descriptive and may support candidate retrieval or manual adjudication; title similarity alone does not establish identity.
classification_policy.numeric_math_role: Digits, decimal points, signs, percentages, stoichiometric subscripts, superscripts, and mathematical symbols may be normalized only to generate retrieval or display variants. Their agreement is not identity evidence, and a substantive conflict cannot be normalized away.
classification_policy.baseline_display_comparison: Unicode NFC, case folding, whitespace normalization, and visibly equivalent typographic dash or apostrophe forms are used only to describe title differences. This comparison has no automatic linkage authority.

categories.exact: No scientific-content difference remains after baseline display comparison.
categories.typographic_numeric_math_only: After baseline display comparison, remaining differences are limited to equivalent numeric or mathematical layout, spacing, Unicode subscript/superscript, or markup; values and mathematical roles are unchanged.
categories.substantive_rewrite: Scientific wording is added, removed, abbreviated, reordered, or materially rephrased without a directly contradictory corresponding number.
categories.substantive_numeric_conflict: A corresponding scientific value, sign, exponent, dimension, percentage, or stoichiometric number differs; this is a substantive conflict, not a display variant.

summary.interpretation: This is a descriptive complete-case sample assembled from existing audits, not a random or exhaustive sample of retrieved and non-retrieved journal records. The observed counts cannot estimate population linkage precision or recall; zero substantive numeric conflicts in this sample is not evidence that such conflicts are absent.
